name: @measurekit/core
description: The foundation that the measurekit packages share: their errors, the checks of their arguments, a seeded random number generator and common numerics.
author: Fariz Wakan (https://github.com/luthfanwakan)

scripts.clean: node --eval "for (const path of ['dist', 'tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.check:packages: pnpm build && publint --pack pnpm --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only
